1931 active offers from 1677 merchants

Chase Offers are merchant-specific deals available to Chase credit and debit cardholders. You can earn cashback or bonus Ultimate Rewards points when you activate an offer and shop at that merchant. Chase Offers appear in the Chase app and online banking portal.

Tip: Chase Offers can be stacked with category bonuses on cards like the Chase Sapphire Preferred or Freedom Flex for even higher returns.

Offer.love tracks all 1931 active Chase offers across 1677 merchants — updated multiple times daily so you never miss a deal.

About Chase Offers

How do I find Chase offers?

You can browse all 1931 active Chase offers right here on Offer.love, or install our free Chrome extension to get notified when you visit a merchant with an available Chase offer.

How do I activate Chase offers?

Log into your Chase account, go to the offers section, and add the offer to your card. Then use that card at the merchant to earn automatic cashback or credits.

How many Chase offers are available?

There are currently 1931 active Chase offers across 1677 merchants. New offers are added regularly and Offer.love updates multiple times per day.
